title: fix(plugin-form): refuse a non-positive row cap before it reaches `$top` — the last live read point (objectui#9925)
body:
Part of objectui#9925

⚠️ **`Part of`, not a closing keyword — deliberately.** This is the SECOND and final half of
objectui#9925; the first half merged as `dc4924655`. This half repairs the last live read point, so
the card's population is now empty — but the standard clause keeps that decision with the seat
rather than with a merge, exactly as the first half's body did. objectui#9925 stays open here and is
the seat's to retire once this lands.

## The site — the last live one in the repo

`packages/plugin-form/src/LineItemsPanel.tsx`, the `record:line_items` renderer:

| | spelling on `dc4924655` |
|:--|:--|
| declaration | `DEFAULT_LINE_ITEMS_LIMIT = 500` |
| read point | `$top: schema.limit ?? DEFAULT_LINE_ITEMS_LIMIT` |

`??` rejects only `null` and `undefined`, so an authored `limit: 0` is not nullish and survives as a
real window. It reaches the wire as `$top: 0`, the panel asks the server for nothing, and the empty
line-items grid names no cause. A negative goes out the same way; a non-integer becomes a fractional
window. `@objectstack/spec` declares the element data source `limit` a POSITIVE INTEGER
(`z.number().int().positive().optional()`), and so is the `pagination.pageSize` of a named view that
fills it — so this is a value the contract refuses, not a spelling a renderer may assign a meaning to.

## ⭐ The pin-citation check, taken BEFORE the spelling changed

The first half changed a `$top` expression and a source-text pin in another package went red because
it held the exact old string. That check was re-taken here first, on this branch's base, and reported
either way:

| query | hits | where |
|:--|--:|:--|
| literal `$top: schema.limit ?? DEFAULT_LINE_ITEMS_LIMIT`, whole repo, all carriers | **1** | `LineItemsPanel.tsx` read point only |
| `DEFAULT_LINE_ITEMS_LIMIT` on its own, whole repo | **3** | all three in `LineItemsPanel.tsx` — its JSDoc, its declaration, its read point |
| **CONTROL** — the dispatch's own query form `$top: IDENT ?? DEFAULT` over `packages` | **5** | 4 prose + this one live site |
| **CONTROL** — a known-present literal (`export const DEFAULT_LINE_ITEMS_LIMIT`) | **1** | proves the fixed-string instrument fires |

⇒ **No pin cites the spelling**, so nothing needed re-pointing. Both controls return non-zero on the
same corpus and the same form, so that zero is a reading and not a dead grep.

### ⭐ But two source-text censuses DO walk this exact file — a refinement on the dispatch's reading

The dispatch measured only the `$top` spelling and concluded no pin holds this file. That is correct
as far as it goes, and it understates the exposure. Two censuses read `LineItemsPanel.tsx` as TEXT:

| census | what it scans this file for |
|:--|:--|
| `packages/plugin-form/src/LineItemsPanel.parentIdNoCast-9333.test.ts` | a type assertion applied to any `record?.recordId` read, and that the file still contains `LineItemsPanel` and `useRecordContext` |
| `packages/react/src/context/__tests__/useRecordContext.bindingCast.pin.test.ts` | keeps this file in `KNOWN_CONSUMERS`; it must keep binding `useRecordContext` and must not assert on it |

Neither cites the row cap, so neither needed re-pointing — but a repair here that added a cast near
the parent-id read, or dropped the `useRecordContext` binding, would have reddened them for reasons
unrelated to this card. Both were run and are green. ⛔ No pin was deleted, skipped, loosened or
weakened.

## The shape — the fifth file-local copy, ⛔ not an extraction

Mirrors what `dc4924655` landed at three read points, in this file, file-local and unexported:

- `isUsableRowLimit(value)` — `typeof value === 'number' && Number.isInteger(value) && value > 0`.
- `resolveRowLimit(authored, fallback)` — one resolver at the entry, so the answer is single.
- `describeRefusedRowLimit(authored, childObject)` — returns `null` for absent AND for usable, a
  message otherwise. ⛔ NOT a second predicate: it reads `isUsableRowLimit`, so the two cannot drift.
- The warning fires from an **effect** keyed on the declaration, ⛔ never from render.
- **FAIL-SOFT**: the value is dropped and the panel's own default (500, unchanged) is used. ⛔ Not a
  throw, which would take out the panel over one declaration. ⛔ Not a clamp to 1 either: the
  author's number is refused, ⛔ not repaired.

⛔ **No shared helper was extracted.** A shared home would be `@object-ui/core`, which is
objectui#9928's package and out of this card's face. Adding a fifth copy is the correct act today.

Both entrances converge on `schema.limit`, which is why the repair sits at the read point:
`RECORD_LINE_ITEMS_DATA_SOURCE` maps `limit: 'limit'`, so a bound view's `pagination.pageSize` is
lowered into the same key a panel with no binding reads directly. A repair at the lowering layer
would close only the first — and the pin asserts both separately.

## The defect reproduced, then refused — same pin, same command

The new pin was written and run BEFORE the source changed, against pristine base bytes.

| | result | the `$top` array that reached the adapter |
|:--|:--|:--|
| **BEFORE** the change | 14 failed, 6 passed | authored entrance: `expected [ +0 ] to not include +0`; bound entrance: `expected [ +0 ] to not include +0` |
| **AFTER** the change | **20 passed** | the panel's own default |

The 6 rows that passed in BOTH runs are the controls — a legitimate limit still reaching `$top`, an
absent limit still defaulting, the bound view's filter still arriving, and the two silence controls.
They did not move with the fix, which is what keeps the 14 that did move a reading.

⭐ No mutation/restore leg was needed or used: the BEFORE reading was taken on the unmodified base
file, so nothing had to be put back.

| gates | `check:control-bytes` `check:new-line-citations` `check:changeset-claims` `check:pending-changeset-literals` `check:comment-mask-corpus` `check:test-path-roots` `check:element-data-source-declaration` | all exit 0 |
| changeset | `node scripts/check-changeset-presence.mjs` | exit 0 — 1 source file of 1 released package, 1 changeset declared |

Heavy runs were serialized through the shared verify lock; each reports `VERDICT command-exit 0`.
Repo-wide `pnpm lint` and the full suite are CI's runs, ⛔ not claimed here.

## Acceptance notes

- The four other hits of the `$top: IDENT ?? DEFAULT` query form are **prose**, not executable code
  (two in `plugin-kanban/src/index.tsx`, one in `app-shell`'s preview block-config, one in the
  objectui#7322 pin file's historical paragraph). They are the control on that query and are fenced
  out of scope, as the dispatch directed. Noted, not filed — the merged first half already records
  them with no carrier named.
- `LineItemsPanel.tsx` carries a pre-existing lint warning about calling setState synchronously
  within an effect, at its `childObject` decline. It predates this card (same call on `origin/main`)
  and is untouched here. Noted, not filed; carrier: none.
- This repo has no `Clause-②` line convention in its claim comments or PR bodies — the merged
  first-half PR carries none either — so none was copied onto this body.
